# LED ORIGAMI FROG

# Description

This project is a paper-folding craft model with an LED light. It can also be used as a simple toy for playing. The LED adds an attractive lighting effect to the model 

# Required Materials

* Coloured paper  
* LED  
* Scissor  
* Tape  
* Coin Battery  
* Aluminium Foil

# Procedure

1\. Take a coloured paper and fold it into the required toy shape.

            2\. Cut and fold the paper properly using scissors.  

            3\. Fix the folded parts using tape.

            4\. Place the LED at the top of the paper model.

            5\. Use aluminium foil as conducting strips to connect the LED to the battery.

            6\. Connect the LED to the coin battery with the correct polarity.

            7\. Secure the battery and connections with tape.

            8\. Check the connection by pressing the foil contact; the LED glows.

            9\. The paper model can then be used as a simple light-up toy for playing.

![Procedure](Procedure.jpg)

# Uses and Applications

# 

- [ ] # Used as a simple light-up toy for children.

# 

- [ ] # Used for creative paper craft activities.

# 

- [ ] # Helps to understand the basic working of an LED and battery.

# 

- [ ] # Can be used as a decorative model.

# 

- [ ] # Useful for school/college science and electronics projects.
